releases.title: S4 Capital's Monks Boosts Media Acceleration Offering with Executive Appointments in North America and Returning Global Partnership Leaders
releases.body:
Appointments of Amman Badlani and Kerry Curran, alongside returning leaders Tobey Van Santvoord and Lucy Weber, signal agency momentum in unified, algorithm-driven media, retail, and commerce execution

NEW YORK and BOSTON and SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Monks, the global, digital-first operating brand of S4Capital plc, today announced a strategic expansion of its Data & Media practice leadership. The agency has appointed Amman Badlani as Senior Vice President, Commerce & Retail Media, North America, and Kerry Curran as Senior Vice President, Integrated Media, North America. Concurrently, Monks announced the return of senior leaders Tobey Van Santvoord and Lucy Weber to lead strategic platform partnerships across Amazon, Meta and more.

The combined moves highlight Monks' investment in top-tier Data & Media talent and strengthen Media Acceleration, the company's approach to delivering media relevance at scale. Constant platform algorithm changes, retail media networks, and answer-engine ecosystems have upended the traditional media model, and creative is now the new targeting. Media Acceleration answers with high volumes of varied creative, algorithm-first activation and layered measurement, anchored in proprietary technology, a transparent commercial model, client ownership of their data, and causal incrementality measurement.

Based in New York, Amman Badlani joins as SVP, Commerce & Retail Media, North America, bringing more than two decades of experience, including 13 years at agency networks leading search and commerce for brands such as Haleon, Unilever and Signet, and growing the business he oversaw to more than $2 billion in media investment. Reporting to Gila Wilensky, EVP, Head of North America Media and Data at Monks, Badlani architects integrated retail media and marketplace strategies across Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Kroger Precision Marketing and Google, increasingly powered by agentic AI systems he builds and deploys.

Based in Boston, Kerry Curran joins as SVP, Integrated Media, to lead integrated media across North America, uniting paid, owned, and first-party data into a single growth system for enterprise brands. A senior commercial executive with more than two decades running revenue-bearing media businesses, Curran served on the executive committee of a 1,500+ person performance organization, where she merged siloed channel teams into a centralized center of excellence, returned a declining $100M managed media business to 40% year-over-year growth, and commercialized proprietary AI-powered media planning and measurement platforms, most recently deploying custom AI agents to transform commercial operations. Curran will also report to Gila Wilensky, EVP, Head of North America Media and Data at Monks.

Complementing the addition of Badlani and Curran, the return of Weber and Van Santvoord strengthens Monks' platform-native capabilities at a moment when algorithmic efficiency and creative variety dictate performance. Lucy Weber re-joins Monks to lead Meta platform partnerships, aligning high-velocity creative assets directly with automated media buying environments like Meta Advantage+. Tobey Van Santvoord re-joins to lead global partnerships, including the company's Amazon partnership, focusing in the near-term on harnessing partner ecosystems to deliver integrated intelligence, scaled creative, end-to-end campaign orchestration and advanced measurement. Both Weber and Van Santvoord will report to Chris Wilhelmi, Monks EVP, Global Head of Data & Media.

"The legacy agency model of keeping media, creative, commerce, and data in separate silos is completely broken," said Chris Wilhelmi, EVP, Global Head of Data & Media at Monks. "Brands waste immense growth potential when these disciplines don't operate as one system. We are bringing together top-tier talent to offer a clear alternative: a unified, agile Data & Media practice built on Monks.Flow, our intelligent platform, which connects intelligence, creative, activation and measurement so brands can scale what works across every market."

For further information, please contact:

Sarah Murray, Senior Director, Global Public Relations & Communications, Monks

sarah.murray@monks.com

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger's Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek's first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show's inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group's 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

About S4 Capital

S4 Capital is a purely digital advertising and marketing services business built for global, multinational, regional, and local clients and millennial-driven influencer brands. The business operates through two data and digital media driven Practices: Marketing Services and Technology Services, emphasising 'faster, better, cheaper, more' execution in an always-on consumer-led environment. Its unitary structure positions the Company as a systems integration partner delivering real-time relevance in the post-agency era.

The Company now has approximately 6,350 people in 33 countries with approximately 80% of net revenue across the Americas, 15% across Europe, the Middle East and Africa and 5% across Asia-Pacific. The longer-term objective is a geographic split of 60%:20%:20%. Marketing Services accounted for approximately 90% of net revenue, and Technology Services 10%. The target allocation is a practice split of 75%:25%.

Sir Martin Sorrell was CEO of WPP for 33 years, building it from a £1 million 'shell' company in 1985 into the world's largest advertising and marketing services company, with a market capitalisation of over £16 billion on the day he left. Prior to that, Sir Martin was Group Financial Director of Saatchi & Saatchi Company Plc for nine years.

Silberman joins the firm after twenty years at A+E Global Media, where he most recently served as Executive Vice President of Communications. He reports to Sol Managing Partner Kaan Aslansan and will be based in New York.

Silberman will own Sol's brand, marketing and communications strategy end to end, covering positioning and narrative, earned media, content and thought leadership, digital presence, internal communications and reputation management, with the work tied to pipeline and growth.  Sol takes enterprise clients from AI strategy to live implementation, including agentic AI systems, workflow modernization and workforce transformation, with a core focus in Media, Entertainment & AdTech, as well as state and local government and education (SLED).

He arrives during the firm's fastest period of expansion. Sol has built out a dedicated AI Acceleration practice under Steve Miller, formerly Chief Digital Officer at Xerox, with former Xerox CEO Steven Bandrowczak as senior advisor, taking clients from diagnosis to live agentic systems. Sol also recently launched its first industry-aligned practice, Media, Entertainment and AdTech, under newly appointed practice lead Ashley J. Swartz.

Silberman joins from A+E Global Media, where he led media relations, corporate and internal communications, crisis management, social strategy and talent relations for The HISTORY Channel, A&E Network, A+E Factual Studios and Oscar-winning feature division A&E IndieFilms, brands reaching more than 400 million households across 200 territories. Earlier, at NBCUniversal, he led press and publicity for Bravo Media, overseeing a full rebrand from its performing-arts roots, launching Queer Eye and Project Runway, and helping transform the network into a pop-culture phenomenon.  He began his career at New York's preeminent public relations firm, Rubenstein Communications, and holds a Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy, Politics & Law from Binghamton University. He has been named to The Hollywood Reporter's Next Gen list and Multichannel News' 40 Under 40, received the CableFAX Award for PR Executive of the Year, and serves on the Board of Directors of LMC Media, the largest tri-state area community media center outside of New York City.

"We've built Sol on the strength of our delivery. Now we're investing in making sure the market knows it," said Kaan Aslansan, Managing Partner at Sol. "Dan has built and defended brands under genuine public scrutiny, at a scale most firms never touch. He's exactly what this next phase of growth needs, and he'll make sure the market sees what our clients already do."

"Twenty-five years in television taught me that attention follows the story you tell about your work, not just the work itself," said Silberman. "Sol is competing with firms several times its size and winning, which is the rare case where the story is sitting right there waiting to be told. I'm joining a team of doers that is reshaping how their clients operate, and I'm here to make sure it sounds like it. I've made a career of learning a new business from the best people in it. I want Sol to be the name people already know when we walk in the room."

About Sol

Founded in 2020 and led by Managing Partners Kaan Aslansan, Daniel Gavula, and Carl Graves, Sol is a technology-agnostic business and IT transformation firm that utilizes AI to redesign how companies operate and deliver measurable results, from strategy and operating model design to adoption across the workforce.  Its Sprint 0 discovery process pairs seasoned practitioners with SAGE, Sol's proprietary AI engine, to deliver implementation-ready plans in four to eight weeks rather than the three to six months traditional discovery takes. Sol delivers enterprise AI strategy, agentic AI implementation, workflow modernization, and workforce transformation for clients across industries and public-sector agencies, and measures itself on outcomes rather than recommendations. releases.title: Entertainment Software Rating Board Names Ratings Veteran Orit Michiel as President
releases.body:
Former Netflix and Motion Picture Association executive brings more than two decades of experience in age ratings, content standards and children's safety

NEW YORK, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) today announced that Orit Michiel will become its president, effective November 2, 2026. Michiel will lead the video game industry's efforts in helping parents make informed decisions about video games and apps through age and content ratings, resources for families, industry advertising standards and the ESRB Privacy Certified program. Michiel will also serve on the Board of Directors for the International Age Rating Coalition (IARC), which provides global age ratings for digitally delivered games and apps.

Michiel brings extensive experience developing and strengthening age-rating systems across the entertainment industry. At Netflix, she served as Director, Content Policy, leading the global Content Policy team and developing a global classification and maturity-rating system. Before joining Netflix, Michiel spent 13 years at the Motion Picture Association (MPA), serving as Vice President, Legal Affairs, and chair of the Classification and Rating Appeals Board. She led a comprehensive overhaul of the motion picture industry's U.S. rating and advertising guidelines, working with industry partners, regulators and international ratings bodies on content classification and child protection.

"Orit understands the responsibility that comes with providing trusted age ratings and the numerous positive benefits of interactive entertainment on our society and culture," said Strauss Zelnick, Chairman and CEO of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., and Chair, Board of Directors of the Entertainment Software Association (ESA) and ESRB. "Her experience across the entertainment industry, and her deep knowledge of classification systems, makes her an exceptional choice to lead ESRB for the future. She will build on its longstanding commitment to giving parents clear, reliable information to decide what is right for their families and ensuring that our self-regulated industry continues to adhere to its stringent guidelines and practices."

As president, Michiel will oversee ESRB's age and content rating system, enforcement of advertising and marketing guidelines adopted by the video game industry, and Privacy Certified program, which helps companies implement responsible privacy practices. Michiel will replace Patricia Vance, who is retiring after more than 20 years in her role as ESRB president.

"Interactive entertainment sparks imagination, inspires learning and brings families together. Parents deserve clear, useful information to help them choose gameplay experiences that are right for their children," said Michiel. "ESRB has earned parents' trust and empowered them with that information. I am honored to lead this team and build on its work to help families make confident choices as video games and the ways people play continue to evolve."

Michiel began her career practicing law. She holds a J.D. from the UCLA School of Law and a B.A. in Political Science from UCLA.

About ESRB

The ESRB is a non-profit, self-regulatory body that independently assigns age and content ratings for video games and mobile apps so parents can make informed choices. It also enforces advertising guidelines adopted by the video game industry and helps companies implement responsible online, mobile and internet connected device privacy practices under its Privacy Certified program. Visit www.esrb.org for more information.

BROOKFIELD, Wis., Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Best Version Media (BVM), a local media and marketing company serving more than 1,300 communities across the United States and Canada, today announced that Chris Laurence has joined the company as Chief Executive Officer. Kevin O'Brien, who previously served as CEO, will transition to Chief Revenue Officer, focusing on leading BVM's sales field and accelerating revenue growth.

The appointments reflect BVM's investment in leadership to support its next stage of growth. By establishing dedicated executive leadership for the broader organization and the sales field, BVM is strengthening its ability to execute across the business while supporting its independent Publishers and the local businesses they serve.

"Our growth has brought us to a point where leading the overall company and leading our sales field each deserve a dedicated focus," said O'Brien. "This transition allows me to concentrate on working with our sales leaders and Publishers, strengthening the field, and helping more local businesses connect with their communities. I'm excited to partner with Chris as we build on BVM's momentum."

Laurence brings experience as CEO, CFO, and COO of public, private, and private equity-backed companies, where he has led growth, operational improvement, and technology transformation. Before moving into operating roles, he was a general partner at Brentwood Associates, a Los Angeles-based private equity firm.

"BVM has built a powerful combination of community storytelling, local relationships, and marketing solutions for small businesses," said Laurence. "I look forward to working with Kevin and the entire team to build on that foundation, strengthen how we operate, and support the success of our Publishers and clients."

As CEO, Laurence will lead BVM's overall strategy and operations, working with the team to scale operations and support the success of our Publishers and the local businesses they serve. As CRO, O'Brien will focus on sales leadership, Publisher growth, and revenue generation. Together, they will help advance BVM's print and digital offerings and position the company for continued growth.

Founded in 2007, Best Version Media (BVM) connects local businesses with customers through community magazines, targeted digital advertising, and online presence management tools. Serving more than 1,300 communities across the United States and Canada, BVM's network of independent Publishers builds relationships with local businesses and brings community stories to life. BVM is a portfolio company of H.I.G. Capital. To learn more, visit www.bestversionmedia.com.

NEW YORK, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great American Media announced today that Kellie Barnes has joined the company as Vice President of Marketing , bringing more than three decades of entertainment marketing experience spanning film, music, live events and faith-based entertainment.

Kellie Barnes joins Great American Media as VP of Marketing, bringing experience in entertainment and audience growth.

In her new role, Barnes will bring her expertise in integrated marketing, audience development, strategic partnerships and brand strategy to Great American Media's growing portfolio.

"Kellie understands how to connect great content with the audience it was created to serve," said Kaitlyn Haubrich, Chief Brand Officer and Chief of Staff, Great American Media. "She brings a strong combination of entertainment marketing experience, strategic thinking and a real understanding of the faith and family audience. As Great American Media continues to grow, Kellie will be an important part of how we strengthen our brands and reach new viewers."

Barnes most recently served as Head of Marketing for Smallbone Management/for KING + COUNTRY, where she oversaw marketing, promotions, public relations and partnerships across film and streaming projects. Her work included marketing and PR strategy for music and film releases, documentary campaigns, sponsorships, licensing and audience-growth initiatives.

Prior to that, she spent more than eight years as Director of Marketing at Fathom Entertainment, leading integrated marketing, strategic partnerships and event marketing for theatrical releases and cinema events distributed nationwide. Barnes directed campaigns for theatrical events, live broadcasts, concerts, documentaries and specialty programming and led a team responsible for more than 25 – 30 theatrical events annually.

Earlier in her career, she spent 20+ years with Allied Integrated Marketing, ultimately serving as Vice President of Marketing. There, she launched the company's specialty Faith Marketing Division and led national and regional campaigns for major motion picture studios including Warner Bros., Paramount Pictures, Lionsgate and Fox Searchlight Pictures.

Barnes' career has centered on building integrated campaigns that increase brand awareness, strengthen audience engagement and support business growth while working across creative, publicity, digital, production and executive teams.

ABOUT GREAT AMERICAN MEDIA

Great American Media is a leader in faith and family entertainment and one of the fastest-growing entertainment networks on television. Great American Media is home to a growing portfolio of entertainment brands that celebrate faith, family, and country, including Great American Family, the flagship linear network featuring original Christmas movies, romantic comedies, and beloved series; Great American Pure Flix, a leading faith and family streaming service; Great American Faith & Living, the unscripted companion network; GFam+, an app that lets viewers watch anytime, anywhere; and Pure Flix Familia, a Spanish-language streaming service featuring original and curated entertainment that celebrates Latino culture, faith, and family traditions.

Established in June 2021 by Bill Abbott and a group of U.S.-based family offices, Great American Media reaches audiences through cable television, streaming services, YouTube TV, and the GFam+ app. Across its expanding portfolio, the company delivers original movies, series, and family-friendly programming, connecting audiences with uplifting entertainment rooted in faith, family, and country.

Former chef and food service leader joins the farmer-founded brand to expand the reach of its award-winning, USDA-certified organic beverages

DENVER, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tractor Beverage Company, the farmer-founded, employee-owned organic beverage company, today announced the appointment of Clay Lichterman as Senior Vice President of Sales, reporting to Chief Revenue Officer John Murphy. A former chef with experience helping launch numerous companies into foodservice, Lichterman joins Tractor to build on the channel where the brand got its start.

Tractor began in foodservice more than a decade ago, partnering with restaurants to make USDA Certified Organic beverages part of the everyday dining experience. Its portfolio includes organic fountain beverages, lemonades, teas, and fruit-forward refreshers, along with Haymaker, its organic apple cider vinegar sparkling tonic available in cans through food service and retail. Haymaker earned a 2026 NEXTY Award for Apricot Peach and 2026 FABI Awards for all four flavors, with Citrus Ginger named a FABI Favorite. Tractor also earned a place on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies for the fifth consecutive year in 2026, underscoring the momentum Lichterman joins the company to build on.

"Foodservice is where Tractor began, and Clay understands the people and the work at the heart of that channel," said Murphy. "He's been in the kitchen, he's built customer relationships, and he knows how to help a brand grow. Clay brings an operator's perspective to a company built around giving operators something meaningful to serve: great-tasting, organic beverages with a connection to the land. We're excited to have him help bring Tractor to more tables."

Lichterman began working in a kitchen at age 12 and later ran kitchens as a chef. That experience gave him firsthand appreciation for the demands of the restaurant business and the trust suppliers must earn. Throughout his career, he has helped bring four companies into foodservice, build teams, develop channel strategies, and create lasting customer relationships.

"What first drew me to Tractor was how well the brand showed up in foodservice. Then I got to know the people, the products, and the purpose behind them," said Lichterman. "I'm excited to join a brand with such a clear commitment to organic. The brand's Organic Impact Tracker makes that commitment tangible, giving operators something to share with guests that connects the beverages they serve to the organic farmland they support and the synthetic pesticides they help avoid. That's a powerful story to bring to the table, and I'm excited to help more partners become part of it."

Lichterman brings a team-first approach shaped by a lifelong connection to sports and coaching. His emphasis on shared goals, accountability and caring for the people around him aligns with Tractor's belief in Soil & Soul: that soil is the foundation of life and soul is the foundation of living. 

ABOUT TRACTOR

Farmer-founded and employee-owned, Tractor is built on the belief that a better food system starts with the land—and the people who care for it. We craft every beverage with USDA Organic-certified ingredients and a commitment to supporting soil health. We make drinks that taste great, drive real impact, and raise awareness of regenerative practices that nourish both the earth and the communities it sustains.

Through the Farmhand Foundation, we help secure farming's future by connecting growers with financial tools, education, and regenerative supply chains. And with our Organic Impact Tracker, we provide unprecedented transparency into the environmental benefits of organic sourcing, helping partners see the measurable difference every sip makes.

For more information, visit drinktractor.com or follow @drinktractor on Instagram.

releases.body:
Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year to be Revealed During Celebration of  the Year's 50 Most-Performed Country Songs

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BMI will celebrate one of the ultimate architects of modern Country music, Jeffrey Steele, by naming him a BMI Icon during the 74th annual BMI Country Awards. The two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year will be recognized for his significant songwriting and contributions to Country music. The invitation-only event will be held at BMI's Nashville office on Nov. 17th and will be hosted by BMI's CEO, Mike O'Neill, Executive Vice President, Chief Revenue & Creative Officer, Mike Steinberg and BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley.

Throughout the evening, BMI will also reveal the Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year, while celebrating the top songwriters and music publishers behind this past year's 50 most-performed songs in Country music.

"Jeffrey Steele is a titan of modern storytelling whose catalog has shaped the sound of Country music over the last three decades," BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley said. "When you hear one of his anthems that has become the soundtrack to millions of lives, you can feel the emotion behind every lyric. As a two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year and an intentional mentor to the next generation of creators, Steele has earned a permanent place among the greats."

Since Steele's affiliation with BMI in 1981, the multi-Platinum songwriter, singer and producer has shaped the modern Country music landscape with over 60 chart-topping hits. The prolific songwriter has received more than 34 BMI Country and Pop Awards for his extensive catalog that includes iconic songs like Tim McGraw's "The Cowboy in Me" along with Rascal Flatts' "What Hurts the Most," "My Wish," and "These Days" as well as Keith Urban's "Raise 'Em Up" featuring Eric Church, Zac Brown Band's "Knee Deep," Van Zant's "Help Somebody," Montgomery Gentry's "Something to Be Proud Of" and "My Town." The seven-time GRAMMY® nominee has earned critical recognition for his creative impact with an induction into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, and Steele has been honored by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet."

The BMI Icon Award is given to exceptional songwriters in recognition of their unique and indelible influence on music makers over many generations. In receiving this award, Steele joins an impressive list of Country legends including Bill Anderson, Matraca Berg, Clint Black, Toby Keith, Loretta Lynn, Willie Nelson, Merle Haggard, Dolly Parton, Kris Kristofferson, Dean Dillon, Vince Gill and Hank Williams, Jr., as well as multi-genre creative/songwriting royalty Stevie Nicks, Little Richard, Carole King, Patti LaBelle, Brian Wilson, James Brown, Janet Jackson, Bo Diddley, Holland-Dozier-Holland, Peter Gabriel, Al Green, Van Morrison, Sting, Bryan Ferry, Carlos Santana, Los Lobos, and more.

ABOUT JEFFREY STEELE:

Jeffrey Steele continues to shape American music with songs that connect people across generations. With more than 65 million radio and television airplays, his songwriting has produced major hits for artists including Keith Urban, Eric Church, Zac Brown Band, Jimmy Buffett, Montgomery Gentry, Lynyrd Skynyrd, Cher, .38 Special, Faith Hill, Tim McGraw, Trace Adkins, LeAnn Rimes, Rascal Flatts, Van Zant, Joe Cocker, Little Feat ft. Bob Seger, Joe Bonamassa, Cascada, and many more. A member of the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, Steele has been recognized by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet," named BMI Songwriter of the Year twice, and awarded NSAI Songwriter of the Year three times. He is also a two-time CMA Triple Play Award recipient for penning three No. 1 hits in a single year. His extensive list of chart-topping songs includes: "Raise 'Em Up," "Knee Deep," "Here," "My Wish," "The Cowboy in Me," "These Days," "My Town," "Something to Be Proud Of," "Everyday," and the landmark "What Hurts the Most," which earned a GRAMMY® nomination for Best Country Song. Steele has received a Golden Globe and Critics' Choice nominee for Best Original Song for "I Thought I Lost You" (from Disney/Pixar's Bolt). He has been named one of Billboard's Top 5 Writers for eight consecutive years and MusicRow Magazine's Songwriter of the Year. Continuing to use his voice to reflect the times, Steele released his new single "A Voice" in January - a song rooted in hope, unity and shared humanity. Written as a reminder of what connects us in a world often marked by division and uncertainty, the song underscores Steele's enduring belief in music as a force for healing and togetherness. The song debuted at #4 on the Billboard Digital Sales charts. A full-length American Storyteller album of new music will follow. Fore more information visit www.JeffreySteele.com.

ABOUT BMI:

Celebrating over 80 years of service to songwriters, composers, music publishers and businesses, BMI® is a global leader in music rights management, serving as an advocate for the value of music. BMI represents the public performance rights in over 25 million musical works created and owned by more than 1.5 million songwriters, composers, and music publishers. The Company negotiates music license agreements and distributes the fees it generates as royalties to its affiliated writers and publishers when their songs are performed in public. In 1939, BMI created a groundbreaking open-door policy becoming the only performing rights organization to welcome and represent the creators of blues, jazz, country, and American roots music. Today, the musical compositions in BMI's repertoire, from chart toppers to perennial favorites, span all genres of music and are consistently among the most-performed hits of the year. For additional information and the latest BMI news, visit bmi.com, follow us on X, TikTok, and Instagram @BMI or stay connected through BMI's Facebook page. Sign up for BMI's The Weekly™ and receive our e-newsletter every week to stay up to date on all things music.

releases.title: Qorvis Welcomes Veteran Media Executive Victor Shiblie
releases.body:
Washington Diplomat President and Publisher Brings More Than Three Decades of Media, International Business, and Diplomatic Experience to Qorvis

WASHINGTON, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Qorvis today announced that veteran media executive and international business strategist Victor Shiblie has joined the firm as Senior Advisor, bringing more than three decades of experience spanning media, international affairs, global business, and diplomatic engagement.

Shiblie joins Qorvis after a career at the center of Washington's diplomatic and international community. For more than 25 years, he has served as President and Publisher of The Washington Diplomat, one of the capital's leading publications serving the diplomatic community.

Under Shiblie's leadership, The Washington Diplomat built relationships across more than 180 foreign embassies, U.S. government institutions, multinational corporations, and international organizations. He also produced high-level policy forums, international conferences, and economic-development programs bringing together ambassadors, senior government officials, corporate executives, and international leaders.

"Victor understands the power of media, relationships and communications in international affairs because he has spent more than 30 years working at their intersection," said Matt Lauer, Chief Executive Officer of Qorvis. "Few people in Washington have built the breadth of relationships across the diplomatic, media and international business communities that Victor has. He brings extraordinary experience, judgment and connectivity to Qorvis and, most importantly, to our clients."

At Qorvis, Shiblie will advise clients on strategic communications, international business development, market access, and engagement with diplomatic, government, media, and business stakeholders, while helping expand the firm's international network and global business opportunities.

Beyond his media career, Shiblie has extensive experience in international trade and cross-border investment, including connecting investors, developers, government stakeholders and commercial partners on international energy and infrastructure opportunities. He has also advised foreign investors pursuing opportunities in the United States and foreign governments seeking to attract American investment and strengthen commercial ties with the United States.

"Qorvis has built a unique platform combining communications, geopolitical insight, international business, and access to decision-makers around the world," said Shiblie. "I am excited to join a team that understands how these disciplines increasingly intersect and to put my experience and relationships to work for Qorvis clients."

Earlier in his career, Shiblie led marketing and operations for KENO Electronics, an international import-export company serving government, embassy and commercial clients. He has also held civic and international leadership roles with organizations including the Ambassadors Ball Host Committee, Passport DC, the World Affairs Council, and the Arab American Business & Professional Association Institute.

Shiblie holds a B.B.A. in Marketing from Radford University and a certification in export management from the Government of the District of Columbia. He is conversant in Arabic.

ATLANTA and STOCKHOLM, Oct. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Keyfactor, the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, today announced the appointment of former CyberArk CEO Matt Cohen to its Board of Directors. Cohen will also serve as a strategic advisor to Keyfactor CEO Jordan Rackie, providing an additional source of perspective and operating experience as the company enters its next phase of growth and scale.

The appointment coincides with the closing of Keyfactor's previously announced $1 billion-plus growth investment led by Summit Partners and follows the company's recent milestone of surpassing $200 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR). Together, the developments reflect Keyfactor's continued growth and accelerate investment behind its Trust Control Plane and expand its leadership across machine identity, cryptography, AI security and post-quantum readiness.

Cohen most recently served as CEO of CyberArk, where he helped lead one of cybersecurity's defining growth stories and ultimately the company's approximately $25 billion acquisition by Palo Alto Networks. Over more than two decades in technology, Cohen has built and scaled global businesses, led major strategic and operational transformations, and created significant enterprise value. Before becoming CyberArk's CEO in 2023, he served as its Chief Revenue Officer and Chief Operating Officer. Earlier in his career, he held senior leadership roles at PTC, including Executive Vice President of Worldwide Field Operations, helping scale the company beyond $1 billion in ARR.

"As we began thinking about Keyfactor's next chapter with Summit and the rest of our Board, we were very intentional about the experience and perspective we wanted around the table," said Jordan Rackie, CEO of Keyfactor. "As our market opportunity continues to expand, we're entering a phase where scaling with ambition, discipline and operational rigor will be critical."

"Matt was someone we pursued very deliberately. He has operated at the scale we aspire to reach, helped build a category leader in cybersecurity and navigated many of the opportunities and inflection points that lie ahead for Keyfactor. We share similar values around leadership, transparency and how to approach both opportunities and challenges. He brings tremendous experience and judgment to our Board, and I'm equally excited to have him as a strategic and trusted advisor as we navigate Keyfactor's next phase of growth."

Keyfactor has emerged as a global leader at the intersection of machine identity and cryptography as enterprises confront an unprecedented expansion in the number of machines, workloads, applications and AI agents that must be authenticated and trusted. The company's Trust Control Plane represents the next evolution of how enterprises manage trust across these environments. It creates a unified control layer that brings together visibility, intelligence, policy and action across machine identity and cryptography.

"The most exciting companies are often positioned at the intersection of major technology shifts, and that's exactly where I believe Keyfactor sits today," said Cohen. "AI, machine identity, cryptographic modernization and the transition to post-quantum security are converging to create one of the most significant security challenges enterprises will face over the next decade."

"Keyfactor has meaningful scale, a strong culture and a clear vision for where the market is headed. From my early conversations with Jordan, we found a lot of common ground, and I saw a leader who's clear-eyed about what the next level of growth truly demands. I'm excited to join the Board, serve as a strategic advisor to Jordan and help the team capitalize on the tremendous opportunity ahead."

Summit Partners' investment provides additional resources to help accelerate Keyfactor's growth strategy, which focuses on continued product innovation, international expansion, strategic acquisitions and investment across the company's global organization. Cohen's appointment reflects a broader philosophy around preparing Keyfactor for its next phase: continuing to strengthen the leadership team while surrounding the company with Board members, advisors and partners who bring relevant experience from the scale Keyfactor intends to reach.

In commenting on the announcement, Berry said, "the Girls is a natural addition to our growing podcast portfolio, and we're thrilled to continue expanding our slate of distinctive shows that complement our existing lineup while creating new opportunities for our audience to engage with our content."

Albano added, "We're excited to deliver a no-holds-barred format that captures the authenticity and perspectives of the many dynamic women of FOX News Media and beyond."

releases.body:
Former Spotify, Pandora/SiriusXM and Condé Nast executive brings more than two decades of expertise in AI, music discovery and personalization

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, today announced the appointment of Òscar Celma as Senior Vice President, Applied AI and Machine Learning, effective immediately.

A recognized expert in AI, machine learning and music recommendation, Celma has helped shape how people discover and experience music. At Spotify, he helped lead the development of AI-powered personalized listening experiences including AI DJ, Jam and Daylist, as well as personalization and discovery products used by hundreds of millions of listeners worldwide.

Celma will help lead the development and application of AI and machine learning across UMG's global operations, supporting UMG's labels, divisions and businesses. He will report to Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer.

Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer, said, "Òscar brings a unique blend of quantitative and product experience, deep expertise in AI, and a love of music. He's built teams that have delivered and knows how to turn data at scale into useful insights. With the breadth and depth of UMG's data, there's enormous potential for him to help our teams do more for our artists."

Celma said, "I've spent much of my career exploring how technology can serve artists, songwriters and music fans. It's an exciting time to join Universal Music Group, given its industry leadership in using AI to expand what's creatively and commercially possible. I look forward to working with Hannah and leaders across UMG to advance our AI and machine learning capabilities to support human artistry.

Most recently, Celma led Machine Learning and Product Analytics at Condé Nast. Previously, as Director of Engineering at Spotify, he led engineering teams responsible for new listening experiences. He also spent seven years at Pandora/SiriusXM in senior data science leadership roles, focused on machine learning, music discovery, and recommendation. Earlier in his career, he was a Senior Research Scientist at Gracenote and co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer of Barcelona-based BMAT Music Innovators.

Celma holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Digital Communication from Universitat Pompeu Fabra in Barcelona and is a widely published researcher in music information retrieval and recommendation systems. He is the author of the Springer-published book Music Recommendation and Discovery.

Work With Your Handz brings established experience in the industries CertainPath members serve, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical and related skilled trades. That familiarity allows the firm to support hiring across an entire organization, from field technicians and skilled-trades roles to managers, senior leadership and executive search.

A key differentiator for Work With Your Handz is its ability to communicate credibly across both ends of the home-services business. Because its recruiters have direct industry experience, they can ask the technical questions needed to determine whether a candidate genuinely has the skilled-trades background a client requires. That same team is equally comfortable working with owners, senior executives and private-equity-backed home-service organizations navigating growth and leadership transitions.

"Finding and keeping great people continues to be one of the biggest challenges facing home service contractors," said Tim Cummings, Director of Strategic Partnerships & Member Incentives at CertainPath. "Work With Your Handz understands this industry and the realities our members face when it comes to building the teams they need to grow. This partnership gives CertainPath members access to a recruiting resource with deep experience in the skilled trades, from the field to leadership, and we're excited to bring that expertise to our network."

Work With Your Handz joins CertainPath's Partner Network as part of the company's continued expansion into new referral channels and industry partnerships across the skilled trades.

Work With Your Handz is a national workforce solutions firm founded in 2018 to solve a challenge shared across every skilled trade and service-driven industry: finding reliable, qualified people in competitive, labor-constrained markets. Rooted in residential services, the company has built a recruiting blueprint that now supports skilled trades and service organizations across residential, commercial, facilities and industrial-adjacent environments, with direct hire, contract and temp-to-perm solutions covering roles from frontline and apprentice positions through supervisors, managers and executive leadership.
